## About This Site

Approach Media is an exhibition stall design and build company based in Mumbai, India.
Founded in 2002. 23+ years of experience. 6000+ stalls delivered. 14+ countries served.

We provide: custom exhibition stall design, booth fabrication, turnkey project management,
AV & technology integration, double decker / mezzanine stands, and immersive brand experiences.
